# ![](https://app.gusto.com/companies/bf030b7c-6e82-493d-84b7-2ffd2a9a0953/logo?v=1756900424)    Guardian PR LLCDigital Marketing Specialist  Remote  ·   Part time  [Company website](https://guardian.agency/)    [Apply for Digital Marketing Specialist](https://jobs.gusto.com/postings/guardian-pr-llc-digital-marketing-specialist-31dd1349-b133-42bc-a006-c1ce0c834a9a/applicants/new)

We are seeking a part-time or freelance remote Digital Marketing Specialist to support our agency and clients through both strategic planning and hands-on execution.

### About Guardian PR LLC

Guardian is a specialized, strategic communications agency that exists to serve organizations and people driven by faith. Our team of 15 leverages its 150 years of context-specific experience on behalf of 30+ clients to promote their stories and protect their reputations and people. We believe that we are in a unique cultural season and that media (traditional and social), search and internal comms wield more influence than ever before. As such, every organization needs a Guardian for the public sphere.

### Description

### AGENCY OVERVIEW

Guardian is a specialized, strategic communications agency that **exists to** **serve organizations and people driven by faith**. Our team of 15 leverages its 150 years of context-specific experience on behalf of 30+ clients to promote their stories and protect their reputations and people. We believe that we are in a unique cultural season and that media (traditional and social), search and internal comms wield more influence than ever before. As such, every organization needs a Guardian for the public sphere.

### POSITION OVERVIEW

We are seeking a part-time or freelance remote Digital Marketing Specialist to support our agency and clients through both strategic planning and hands-on execution. The ideal candidate will be:

- Full-funnel strategist
- Results-oriented
- High attention to detail
- Technically fluent
- Creative and data-driven

This role requires a high level of marketing expertise, self-direction and the ability to turn insights into action across content, paid ads, automation and analytics. **This role also needs an understanding of faith-based organizations and the unique communications context they operate within.** You’ll thrive here if you enjoy moving between strategy and execution and helping a small team make a big impact.

### KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Develop and execute full-funnel digital marketing strategies that drive brand awareness, lead generation and conversions.
- Manage and optimize paid campaigns across platforms (LinkedIn, Google, Meta, Amazon, etc.).
- Own and operate MailChimp and HubSpot CRM: email marketing: build workflows, segment lists and report performance.
- Lead SEO, GEO and content strategy to increase ad and website performance.
- Monitor, analyze and report on website and advertising analytics using tools like GA4, HubSpot and platform-specific dashboards.
- Identify key insights and opportunities to improve conversion, UX and campaign ROI.
- Track and optimize campaign budgets to maximize ROI.
- Create social media content and manage calendar.
- Create or coordinate basic visual assets (Canva or similar).
- Write or edit ad copy, web content, case studies and more.
- Build webpages and make updates using Squarespace.
- Join client meetings to provide strategy updates or campaign recommendations.
- Collaborate with internal stakeholders and freelancers as needed.

### DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- 8+ years of experience in digital marketing, with proven success across multiple channels.
- Mastery of paid digital advertising (Google Ads, LinkedIn ads, Meta, social media).
- Hands-on experience with HubSpot for CRM, email marketing and automation.
- Strong knowledge of SEO principles and web performance best practices.
- Deep understanding of web and ad analytics, with the ability to turn data into actionable insights.
- Proficiency in AI applications and digital tools.
- Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
- Track record of smart thinking, a great attitude and strong work ethic.
- Excellent communication and project management skills.
- Self-starter mentality with the ability to thrive in a remote, part-time setup.
- Strong understanding of the faith-driven, non-profit sector.

### WHAT WE OFFER

- Competitive compensation.
- Opportunities for personal and professional growth.
- A supportive, collaborative and excellence-driven work environment.
- The chance to make a significant impact in a faith-driven organization.

Resume submissions should be accompanied by a cover letter and a portfolio or links to campaigns you’ve led or helped execute. Please also include a short paragraph detailing how Guardian’s mission and values resonate with you and why you are passionate about serving faith-driven organizations.

[Apply for Digital Marketing Specialist](https://jobs.gusto.com/postings/guardian-pr-llc-digital-marketing-specialist-31dd1349-b133-42bc-a006-c1ce0c834a9a/applicants/new)
